summary: Computed the certificate structure for n_s=15·2^s+1 (scripts/z52d_p2_TO8_Z3065.py): the least Type II divisor certificate (C,d) with d≤3000 for s=1..12 is periodic in s per divisor, e.g. (C,d)=(1,7) hits exactly s≡2 (mod 3) (7 | 60·2^s+5 ⇔ 2^s≡4 mod 7), and (2,23), (6,23), (1,19), (8,31) hit their own residue classes. So the 'recursion' (u,B,C)_s → (u,B,C)_{s+k} exists only along the period of 2 mod d, i.e. it is the Skolem–Mahler–Lech periodicity, not a new recursion. No recursion across all s was found.
